This method requires management to make significant estimates, including the total expected costs or labor hours to complete each project, the progress toward satisfying each performance obligation, and the amount of consideration expected to be received.
In addition, we will likely incur significant expenses related to engineering and design services, product sales, marketing, and distribution activities.
As a result, we will need substantial additional funding to support our continuing operations and pursue our growth strategy.

Until we can generate significant revenue from product sales, if ever, we expect to finance our operations through a combination of public or private equity offerings and debt financings and other sources, such as potential collaboration agreements, strategic alliances and product pre-sales.
No assurance can be given that any future financing will be available or, if available, that it will be on terms that are satisfactory to the Company.
